prompt: Please summarize the Galatians 6:14 from the bible
response:
Galatians 6:14 from the Bible is part of the New Testament and is found in the King James Version (KJV) as follows:

"But let us not grow weary of doing good, for in due season we shall reap, if we faint not."

This verse encourages believers to persevere in their good works, emphasizing that the rewards will come in due time, as long as they do not lose heart.
